narrative: De-escalation signals from Tehran dominate the weekend tape after Iran pledged to halt strikes contingent on a continued US pause, though a naval mine blast in the Strait of Hormuz maintains a geopolitical risk floor. This fragile detente may soften risk-premium demand at the Tokyo open, but the USD's +146bp OIS carry advantage over EUR and its status as the week's G10 leader (1W avg: +0.559%, n=7) anchor a bullish structure. EUR/USD closed Friday at 1.1399 with technicals showing a break below the SMA200, while USD/JPY closed at 163.60, facing potential volatility ahead of Wednesday's FOMC and Friday's BoJ decisions.
